how_to_read: Each case is data the folder route must make true. Conversion cases (section 2) hold a line and the row today's sender stores for it; the others hold what the page's rules give. Values are written as make_cases.py says.

cases.name: convert_a_plain_step
cases.about: a version 1 step record with the two keys capture always writes

cases.name: convert_grad_norm_null_is_a_null_column
cases.about: capture writes grad_norm as null when it has none: a null column

cases.name: convert_a_record_with_no_version
cases.about: a record written before schema_version existed: record_version is null

cases.name: convert_layers_keep_the_model_order
cases.about: layers as a map of structs, in the record's order (10 after 2)

cases.name: convert_a_layer_field_the_struct_cannot_hold
cases.about: a bool in a float field: null in the struct, the field in extra_json

cases.name: convert_a_layer_entry_that_is_not_an_object
cases.about: a null struct keeps the entry's place; the entry travels in extra_json

cases.name: convert_moe_counts_stats_and_top_k
cases.about: the router's maps: counts, stats (two Int64 fields) and top_k

cases.name: convert_the_probe_split_by_column
cases.about: an attention map of exact float32 values and histograms leave probe_json

cases.name: convert_scalars_with_a_bool_and_an_integer_past_2_53
cases.about: the bool and the exact integer travel in extra_json too

cases.name: convert_a_scalar_only_record
cases.about: record version 2: seq in its column, record_version 2, nothing in extra_json

cases.name: convert_a_key_with_no_column
cases.about: a key no column names travels in extra_json, as sorted JSON text

cases.name: convert_an_explicit_null_of_another_key
cases.about: null for a key other than ts and grad_norm travels in extra_json

cases.name: convert_nan_and_infinity_literals
cases.about: bare NaN, Infinity and -Infinity, which Python's json reads

cases.name: convert_a_number_past_the_float_range
cases.about: 1e400 reads as infinity, as Python's json reads it

cases.name: convert_an_integer_past_64_bits
cases.about: a scalar of 30 digits: the nearest float in the column, the exact digits in extra_json

cases.name: convert_a_duplicate_key
cases.about: the last value wins, at the place of the first: ts and a layers entry

cases.name: convert_a_lone_surrogate_in_a_list
cases.about: Arrow cannot hold a lone surrogate: the list travels in extra_json

cases.name: convert_top_k_past_int32
cases.about: moe_top_k is Int32: 3000000000 travels in extra_json and the key is counted as moved

cases.name: convert_a_whole_float_where_an_integer_is_read
cases.about: 2.0 in moe_top_k is not an integer: the map travels in extra_json

cases.name: convert_float_text_in_a_json_column
cases.about: data_json is Python's text (1e+16, 1e-07): the Rust text is compared as JSON values

cases.name: convert_non_ascii_text
cases.about: UTF-8 and an escape in a key with no column: extra_json escapes them (ensure_ascii)

cases.name: convert_a_line_ending_in_a_carriage_return
cases.about: a CRLF line: the carriage return is whitespace to the JSON reader

cases.name: convert_a_line_with_a_byte_order_mark
cases.about: Python's json reads a line that starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark

cases.name: convert_a_line_that_is_not_utf8
cases.about: a byte that is not UTF-8: not a record, skipped and counted

cases.name: convert_a_line_that_is_not_an_object
cases.about: a JSON array: skipped and counted

cases.name: convert_a_line_of_spaces
cases.about: a blank line: passed over and not counted

cases.name: convert_a_line_that_is_not_json
cases.about: half a record, as a killed process leaves it: skipped and counted

cases.name: convert_a_line_of_another_run
cases.about: a record of another run ID than the file's: skipped and counted

cases.name: convert_a_line_with_no_run_id
cases.about: a record with no run_id: skipped and counted

cases.name: convert_a_negative_step
cases.about: an identity field the sender cannot send: left out and counted

cases.name: convert_a_whole_float_step
cases.about: a step of 1.0 is not an integer: left out and counted

cases.name: convert_a_step_past_int64
cases.about: a step past Int64: left out and counted

cases.name: convert_a_rank_past_int32
cases.about: a rank past Int32: left out and counted

cases.name: convert_a_record_version_this_package_does_not_read
cases.about: schema_version 7 is sent with row version 7, for the server to drop and count

cases.name: convert_a_version_2_record_that_is_not_scalar_only
cases.about: record version 2 without record: scalars is left out and counted

cases.name: lines_a_last_line_with_no_newline
cases.about: a last line with no newline is not read until its newline comes; the offset stops before it

cases.name: lines_blank_lines_and_crlf
cases.about: a blank line is read past and not counted; a CRLF line is one line

cases.name: lines_one_line_longer_than_a_batch
cases.about: a line longer than the batch's byte cap is read alone, whole

cases.name: lines_a_file_of_step_and_scalar_only_records
cases.about: step records of versions 0 and 1 and a scalar-only record in one file, in one batch

cases.name: killed_job_torn_tail_then_a_new_session
cases.about: a killed process left half a line; the next session's sink gives it a newline first, so the fragment is a line of its own that is skipped and counted, and the new record is read

cases.name: names_records_and_second_writer
cases.about: the two names a rank's records take, read from the right; a copy is not a records file

cases.name: names_beat_file_and_stop_notice_are_no_records_file
cases.about: the proposed beat file and stop notice names match no name a reader takes for something else
